title: The Sold-Out Zelda Switch 2 Is Coming Back
summary:
Good news for Zelda fans who missed out: the sold-out Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 is coming back very soon. Nintendo announced the special set in September 2026 to mark 40 years of Zelda.

When preorders opened, the set sold out on every storefront in a matter of seconds. The only way to get one was through resellers on eBay, where fans had to pay much more than the retail price.

Now keen-eyed fans have spotted a message on the Nintendo Store page saying that 'more inventory is on the way on January 2027.' The page still lists the set as sold out.

The game itself is a smash hit. The Ocarina of Time remake came out on November 5, 2026, and sold more than 5 million copies in its first four days, making it the second-best-selling Switch 2 game.

The special hardware looks great, too. The controllers and the Switch 2 come in the black, gold and green colors of the hero, Link, along with the Triforce symbol and the Hylian Crest.
why_it_matters: If you missed out on the special Zelda set, you may get another chance to buy it at the normal price.
